name: bhuri-sap
description: Systems Applications and Products in Data Processing

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend:beax-rm && npm run build:frontend:true-process && npm run build:frontend:raccontixrm
scripts.pm2:start:beax-rm:
bash -c 'source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && NODE_ENV=production npm run build:backend && NODE_ENV=production npm run build:frontend:beax-rm && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only "beax-rm-backend,beax-rm-frontend" && echo "
🚀 BeaX RM Started:
📱 Frontend: http://13.126.228.247:4200
🔗 API: http://13.126.228.247:3000/api
"'
scripts.pm2:start:true-process:
bash -c 'source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && NODE_ENV=production npm run build:backend && NODE_ENV=production npm run build:frontend:true-process && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only "true-process-backend,true-process-frontend" && echo "
🚀 True Process Started:
📱 Frontend: http://3.111.139.181:4201
🔗 API: http://3.111.139.181:3001/api
"'
scripts.pm2:start:raccontixrm:
bash -c 'source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && NODE_ENV=production npm run build:backend && NODE_ENV=production npm run build:frontend:raccontixrm && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only "raccontixrm-backend,raccontixrm-frontend" && echo "
🚀 RaccontiXRM Started:
📱 Frontend: http://68.178.171.103:4202
🔗 API: http://68.178.171.103:3002/api
"'
scripts.pm2:restart:beax-rm:
pm2 restart beax-rm-backend beax-rm-frontend && echo '
🚀 BeaX RM Restarted:
📱 Frontend: http://13.126.228.247:4200
🔗 API: http://13.126.228.247:3000/api
'
scripts.pm2:restart:true-process:
pm2 restart true-process-backend true-process-frontend && echo '
🚀 True Process Restarted:
📱 Frontend: http://3.111.139.181:4201
🔗 API: http://3.111.139.181:3001/api
'
scripts.pm2:restart:raccontixrm:
pm2 restart raccontixrm-backend raccontixrm-frontend && echo '
🚀 RaccontiXRM Restarted:
📱 Frontend: http://68.178.171.103:4202
🔗 API: http://68.178.171.103:3002/api
'
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:prod && npm run pm2:restart
scripts.db:reset: echo 'WARNING: This will reset the entire database!' && read -p 'Type YES to continue: ' confirm && [ "$confirm" = "YES" ] && npm run db:setup

author: Rohan Bhuri
